notes:
Mid-market B2B SaaS (collaboration/productivity) exploring migration from current LLM vendor due to repeated latency regressions over last two quarters. Primary driver: chat/agent user experience — streaming + tool calling for real-time assistant inside product.

Context: they run a multi-agent orchestration layer that issues tool calls (search, calendar, ticket API). Incumbent started showing P50/P95 spikes after model rollout in Dec. Users report "stutters" in streaming assistant, hurting adoption. Team sized at ~350 engineers and product folks, cost-conscious but will pay for predictable UX.

POC notes: 2-week Hosted API POC completed. Benchmarks (client-reported, infra validated): incumbent p50 ~230ms, p95 ~560ms for streaming-first flows; Redwood Hosted p50 ~58ms, p95 ~180ms under same request mix (streaming enabled, small tool-call fanout). Tool-calling latency when orchestration waits for function output improved by ~2-3x on Redwood in measurements.

Quotes: "We saw the streaming dropouts disappear on Redwood — real-time feel is back." — Lead PM (call).

Requirements: must support streaming tokens + function/tool calling with end-to-end latency SLOs (p95 target <250ms for assistant response with single external tool call), support SSO/SAML for internal users, SOC2-level assurances, audit logs, and optional EU data residency for customer data. Shortlist includes Hosted for quick rollout and Redwood Dedicated for predictability once committed.

Risks: legal DPA negotiation, procurement commit size, and SSO integration window. Also need longer-term stability numbers (30-day rolling p95) before committing to Dedicated.
